title: Verified Official Census Resources
disclaimer: All links below redirect exclusively to verified official Government of India web domains (.gov.in / .nic.in).

resources.name: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (ORGI)
resources.description: Primary authoritative portal for all Census notifications, circulars, digital self-enumeration portal links, and official metadata.

resources.name: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India (MHA)
resources.description: Nodal ministry responsible for administrative notifications, legal amendments, and statutory orders regarding the Census of India.

resources.name: Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India
resources.description: Public repository of historical Census data tables, demographic datasets, and district-level statistical extracts.

resources.name: Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check Unit
resources.description: Official fact-checking body of the Government of India for verifying viral messages, rumors, and notifications regarding national programs.

resources.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
resources.description: Helpline 1930 and official portal to report cyber fraud, fake phishing websites, or impersonation scams related to public surveys.
